model.description: One row per year, 1960 onward, of French GDP in current US dollars at market exchange rates and in constant US dollars at the provider's base year, with GDP in current and constant euros, the GDP deflator, euros per dollar, and the change in dollar GDP decomposed in log points into real growth, deflator change and exchange-rate change.
model.name: french_gdp_dollar_decomposition

questions.derivation: Select dollar GDP by year and the change in its log, decomposed exactly into the change in log real GDP, in the log deflator, and minus the change in log euros per dollar.
questions.question: How has French GDP measured in US dollars at market exchange rates evolved, and how much of each year's change comes from real growth, domestic price change and the euro-dollar exchange rate?

temporal.meaning: Each period is the first day of the calendar year whose GDP, annual-average exchange rate or change on the previous year the row carries.

validations.description: There is exactly one row per year.
validations.name: unique-period

validations.description: No year is missing, so every change spans one year.
validations.name: years_are_consecutive

validations.description: Every year after the first carries the dollar change and all three terms.
validations.name: every_year_after_the_first_has_its_changes

validations.description: Dollar GDP equals euro GDP divided by euros per dollar within a thousandth in every year, which confirms the pre-1999 conversion from francs.
validations.name: dollar_gdp_is_local_gdp_at_the_exchange_rate

validations.description: The log change in constant-dollar GDP equals real growth within a hundredth of a log point in every year.
validations.name: constant_dollars_grow_with_real_gdp

validations.description: In the base year the provider names, constant-dollar GDP equals current-dollar GDP.
validations.name: constant_dollars_equal_current_dollars_in_the_base_year

validations.description: Real growth, deflator change and exchange-rate change add up to the dollar change in log points within rounding.
validations.name: the_three_terms_add_up_to_the_dollar_change
